key.name: colour-mode
key.description: Which palette to use. 'auto' switches between dark and light on the sunrise/sunset schedule and is resolved by centaur-settingsd.

key.name: accent
key.description: One of the accent ramps in the design system. Must match a key in accent-map.json; an unknown value falls back to the default accent.

key.name: auto-sunrise
key.summary: Time at which 'auto' switches to the light palette

key.name: auto-sunset
key.summary: Time at which 'auto' switches to the dark palette

key.name: wallpaper
key.summary: Absolute path to the wallpaper image

key.name: font-ui
key.summary: Interface font, as a Pango font description

key.name: font-mono
key.summary: Monospace font, as a Pango font description

key.name: layout-start
key.summary: Indicator ids in the start section, in order

key.name: layout-center
key.summary: Indicator ids in the centre section, in order

key.name: layout-end
key.summary: Indicator ids in the end section, in order

key.name: all-outputs
key.summary: Show a bar on every monitor rather than only the first

key.name: clock-format
key.summary: strftime format for the clock indicator

key.name: titlebar-side
key.summary: Which side the titlebar buttons sit on

key.name: titlebar-buttons
key.summary: Which titlebar buttons are shown, in order

key.name: animation-duration
key.summary: Window transition duration in milliseconds; 0 disables
